records.label: Wu Koon Tai v Wu Yau Loi [1997] 2 HKC 154

records.label: Official Administrator v The Luk Hoi Tong Co Ltd [2003] 2 HKLRD 31

records.label: Fu Chuen Sang v Cheung Ching Tak [1961] HKLR 573
records.summary: Certainty of intention: testator's wish for his wife to adopt a son created no trust; precatory words insufficient.

records.label: Re London Wine Co (Shippers) Ltd [1986] PCC 121
records.summary: Certainty of subject matter: tangible bulk not segregated; no trust created over unascertained goods.

records.label: Re Goldcorp Exchange Ltd [1995] 1 AC 74 (PC)
records.summary: Certainty of subject matter: unallocated gold bullion; no proprietary interest passed. PC affirming London Wine.

records.label: Hunter v Moss [1994] 1 WLR 452
records.summary: Certainty of subject matter: intangible shares of the same class do not require segregation for a valid trust.

records.label: Re CA Pacific Finance Ltd [2000] 1 BCLC 494
records.summary: HK application of Hunter v Moss: intangible assets not requiring segregation. Needs paragraph verification.

records.label: JSC Mezhdunarodniy Promyshlenniy Bank v Pugachev [2017] EWHC 2426 (Ch)
records.summary: Sham trust: deeds allowing settlor to freely exercise powers for his own benefit held to be a sham. Needs HK application verification.

records.label: Re Chu Wai Tung (a bankrupt) (No 2) [2013] 5 HKLRD 202
records.summary: Illusory trust: living trust allowing grantors to exhaust assets during their lifetime created no present trust for the son.

records.label: Clayton v Clayton [2016] NZSC 30
records.summary: Illusory trust: trust invalid where settlor retained rights indistinguishable from absolute ownership. Persuasive authority for HK.

records.label: Webb v Webb [2020] UKPC 22
records.summary: Illusory trust: settlor retained powers inconsistent with alienating beneficial interest. Persuasive authority for HK.

records.label: Tsang Tat Hung v Tsang Tat Wing [2005] 3 HKLRD 24

records.label: Gilmour v Coats [1949] AC 426
records.summary: Public benefit: cloistered nuns failed public benefit test because their secluded life provided no demonstrable benefit to the public.

records.label: Dingle v Turner [1972] AC 601
records.summary: Public benefit: poverty trusts may have a more generous test; trust for poor employees of a company may be charitable if not limited to named individuals.

records.label: To Kan Chi v Pui Man Yau (Tsing Shan Monastery) [1995] 2 HKLR 22 (CA)
records.summary: Exclusive charitability: temple not charitable because privately owned by the To Clan; even slight private interest defeats exclusive charitability.

records.label: Secretary for Justice v Joseph Lo Kin Ching [2001] 4 HKCFAR 1
records.summary: Cy-pres / parens patriae: CFA directed an administrative scheme to fulfil Nina Kung's charitable will, establishing a supervising body for a Nobel-level Chinese prize.

records.label: Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale v Islington London Borough Council [1996] AC 669 (HL)

records.label: Cheung Yuk Ying Engarcia v Macgregor Isabella [2003] 2 HKLRD 177
records.summary: Resulting trust: elder cousin's actual intention to hide shares from ex-husband by gifting them to younger cousin defeated resulting trust claim.

records.label: Yau Kwong-Chiu v Yau Kwong-Ha [2007] 3 HKLRD 692
records.summary: Presumption of advancement: survivorship in joint account proven a gift from mother to daughter. Needs paragraph verification.

records.label: Twinsectra Ltd v Yardley [2002] UKHL 12

records.label: Prickly Bay Waterside Ltd v British American Insurance Co Ltd [2022] UKPC 8
records.summary: Quistclose: intention need not be mutual; it is enough if the payer imposes the restriction and the recipient acquiesces.

records.label: Hancock v Watson [1902] AC 14 (HL)
records.summary: Rule in Hancock v Watson: absolute gift with engrafted trust failing results in original gift taking effect, not resulting trust.

records.label: Muschinski v Dodds (1985) 160 CLR 583 (Aus HC)
records.summary: Remedial constructive trust: imposed on pooled resources where unconscionable to deny interest. Australian approach, not adopted in HK.

records.label: Baumgartner v Baumgartner (1987) 164 CLR 137 (Aus HC)

records.label: Attorney-General (HK) v Reid [1994] 1 AC 324 (PC)

records.label: FHR European Ventures LLP v Cedar Capital Partners LLC [2014] UKSC 45

records.label: Thanakorn Kasikorn Thai Chamkat v Cheuk Wan Choi [2019] 2 HKLRD 13 (CFA)

records.summary: Anti-Bartlett clause: CFA affirmed anti-Bartlett provisions are effective; trustees have no residual high-level supervisory duty if deed excludes such duty.

records.label: Spread Trustee Co Ltd v Hutcheson [2011] UKPC 13

records.label: Foskett v McKeown [2001] 1 AC 102 (HL)
records.summary: Tracing into profits: trust money used to pay life insurance premiums; beneficiaries entitled to a proportionate share of the insurance payout.

records.label: Re Hallett's Estate (1880) 13 ChD 696
records.summary: Mixed fund rule: trustee presumed to spend his own money first when drawing from mixed account.
